## Failing tests

- `TestMergeChangelogEntriesUnreleasedLast` (`internal/engine/changelog_test.go`), table, prefix `# Changelog\n\n## Unreleased\n\n`: (a) base `P+"- old\n"`, ours `P+"- S1\n\n- old\n"`, theirs `P+"- S2\n\n- old\n"` want `P+"- S1\n\n- S2\n\n- old\n"`, true; (b) base `P`, ours `P+"- S1\n"`, theirs `P+"- S2\n"` want `P+"- S1\n\n- S2\n"`, true; (c) base `P+"- old"` (no final newline), ours `P+"- S1\n\n- old"`, theirs `P+"- S2\n\n- old"` want `P+"- S1\n\n- S2\n\n- old"`, true. Passes on arrival for all three (measured with a copy of `mergeChangelogEntries` at f48a6154); it pins S180 item 2 and the S180 item 3 fix.
- `TestMergeChangelogEntriesRefusesCRLF`: the three sides of case (a) and of the existing "reviewer example" with every `\n` replaced by `\r\n` give `("", false)`. Passes on arrival (measured); it pins that a CRLF file goes to the owner instead of being rewritten.
- `TestFilesScopeReadsQuotedAndWorktreeRenamedPaths` (`internal/engine/filescope_test.go`): `parsePorcelainZ(" M a\"b.go\x00 R new.go\x00old.go\x00")` is `[]string{"a\"b.go", "new.go", "old.go"}`. Passes on arrival; pins S50 item 1.
- `TestScopeWarningsSiblingDirectoryIsOutside`: `ScopeWarnings([]string{"internal/engine2/x.go", "internal/engine/x.go"}, []string{"internal/engine"})` is `[]string{"internal/engine2/x.go"}`. Passes on arrival; pins S50 item 1.
- `TestDoctorUpgradeReasonNamesTheToolOnce` (`internal/cli/upgrade_test.go`): `buildHints` with tools `{Name: "slicer", Present: true, Version: "slicer 1.22.1"}` and `{Name: "adj", Present: true, Version: "v1.0.0"}` and `all` true gives reasons `requested with --upgrade (installed: 1.22.1)` and `requested with --upgrade (installed: v1.0.0)`. Red first: `(installed: slicer 1.22.1)`.
- `TestDoctorUpgradeReasonShowsTheInstalledVersion` (`internal/cli/upgrade_test.go:725`): its expected text strips a leading `NAME ` from the fixture version the same way.
